repository_and_packs.original_report_correction: A metadata counter initially included four sibling review files as repositories. The corrected report counts only directories containing .git; the original report and executed harness remain retained.

automation.recheck_reason: The first final run exceeded a 25-second harness worker-start allowance during zero-rate recovery and restored-workspace startup. The zero-rate worker subsequently started and its retained state already satisfied the accounting invariants; the first restored worker never reached readiness before cleanup. A fresh recheck used a bounded 90-second startup allowance and explicit process cleanup if readiness fails. Autopilot was recreated solely as the backup fixture prerequisite.
scope: Installed 0.3.1 wheel, real loopback HTTP adapter subprocesses, actual dedicated CLI workers and SQLite workspaces on the iMac volume.
Natural worker polling and lease expiry; SIGKILL recovery does not alter database timestamps or replay ambiguous attempts.
Seven acceptance invariants verified across preserved original and recheck attempts. This is not a claim that every original phase passed.

Backup restoration uses the documented SQLite restore plus a separate artifact copy. This does not measure startup or service-level latency under controlled host load.

lifecycle.audit_note: The original successful phase recorded a checkpoint before a redundant final pause appended an event. Its checkpoint is not represented as the final campaign head; the future harness now avoids that append.
lifecycle.plan_note: The original stage marker hashed regenerated creation metadata instead of the persisted plan. The retained source, model/task snapshots, and plan remain available. Future admission now hashes the exact retained plan and freezes model definitions.
lifecycle.diagnostic_exclusion: All 48 original Autopilot trials are excluded from accuracy claims. Eighteen raw failures revealed undocumented output formatting in two tasks; none established a violation of the public instructions. Old grades and costs remain retained.

pilot.provenance_limit: The early pilot result did not retain installed-code or executed-harness digests; package version comes from its retained campaign manifest.

token_cost_reconciliation.scope: All retained pilot, lifecycle and benchmark provider admissions, including failed semantic grades. Token quantities multiplied by frozen declared prices; not a provider invoice.

live_openai.cost_basis: Reported token counts times conservative declared rates; input charged at cache-write upper bound, output at Standard rate. No cache discount. Not an invoice.

provenance.source_manifest_scope: Publication-time checkout of the listed package and acceptance files, not the exact tree executed by every earlier phase. It excludes unlisted files, including source tests and frontend sources. Executed harness and installed-runtime hashes are reported separately.

provenance.candidate_builds: Successive 0.3.1 candidates were used. The final installed package contains all five fixes; changed controls were checked against that package. Earlier phase package identities and scripts remain retained.
